title: Agent Studio read through Niklas Luhmann
summary: A long-form theory Dossier that reads every major part of Agent Studio through Niklas Luhmann's systems theory: the system of recorded decisions and its environment, meaning and reduction, first- and second-order observation with blind spots and re-entry, expectations and double contingency, structural coupling and the person form, codes and programmes, organisation and decision (premises, positions, uncertainty absorption, membership), formal and informal organisation and useful illegality, tokens and attention, trust, risk and danger, the magazine as the system's mass media against the news selectors, self-description, memory and forgetting, and Dossiers and the Wiki as a slip box. It separates theory, reading and limit, rates each analogy, adds a glossary with German terms, four diagrams and light and dark captures of the board, a review verdict and the Wiki, and derives fifteen design principles carried by existing persona and operator cards plus nine draft slices (LS-1 to LS-9) across eight decisions.

openDecisions.question: What status the theory reading has
openDecisions.recommendation: B: a lens with fifteen principles carried by cards; product vocabulary unchanged.
openDecisions.rejectedOption: Essay only; theory vocabulary in product.

openDecisions.question: Codes, coverage and programmes in review
openDecisions.recommendation: B: coverage beside every verdict, no pass with missing required material, programme revision on verdicts, codes unchanged, inventory.
openDecisions.rejectedOption: Keep as is; a fourth verdict value.

openDecisions.question: Observing observers and reopening absorbed uncertainty
openDecisions.recommendation: B: cross-observer misses in the scout and a capped weekly re-review sample of accepted cards.
openDecisions.rejectedOption: Per-persona misses only; full re-review with raw evidence.

openDecisions.question: Magazine, persistent dangers and the owner's attention
openDecisions.recommendation: C: PT-8 plus still-open register, two reserved slots, weekly attention allowance of five decision requests, risk line on protection requests.

openDecisions.question: Formalising informal practice
openDecisions.recommendation: C: safety rules at once, owner-held recorded deviation, monthly operator-log review that proposes rules.

openDecisions.question: Forgetting
openDecisions.recommendation: C: one retention and forgetting inventory with a guard test.

openDecisions.question: The knowledge base as a slip box
openDecisions.recommendation: B: 'Linked from' lists for Wiki pages and Dossiers from a backlink index.
openDecisions.rejectedOption: Folder tree only; atomic notes migration.

openDecisions.question: Model changes as personnel changes
openDecisions.recommendation: B: persona records split by resolved model route with personnel-change history.

implementationTasks.title: LS-1 · Coverage beside every review aspect verdict

criteria: An aspect whose required material is missing never yields pass, proven by one test per aspect
Every new aspect verdict record carries observed and missing material

implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
# Coverage beside every review aspect verdict

Source: docs/luhmann-systems-theory/index.html (AGT-3606), decision LT-D2, principle P4. Read that Dossier's sections Observation, Codes, Alternatives LT-D2, then AGENTS.md, docs/start/contribution-and-style-guide.html and docs/system/domains/review.md and docs/system/domains/pipeline.md (review/aspect evidence contract). Use the Dossier's recommended option unless a recorded owner decision selects another, and record in results/status.md which option you implemented. Persona slice keys (PT-n) map to AGT-3594 to AGT-3605 by assumption; confirm against card titles before depending on them.

Dependencies: none.

Entry points: backend/Features/Runner/AspectVerdict.cs, backend/Features/Runner/ReviewDecisionOrchestrator.cs, the aspect runners for requirement-fit / concept-fit, code-quality, documentation-impact, tests-and-evidence and visual-review, the review evidence view in the frontend task detail (Code Reviews tab).

## Deliver
1. Declare per aspect the material it requires (for example branch diff, results inventory, screenshots for visual changes) in one versioned policy next to the aspect configuration.
2. Record on every aspect verdict a coverage object: observed material and missing required material.
3. When required material is missing, never settle `pass`: use the existing `Inconclusive` path where that settlement supports it, otherwise `concerns` with the typed reason `not-observed:<material>`. Do not add a value to `AspectStatus`.
4. Show a one-line coverage statement beside the verdict chip in the review view.

## Out of scope
New verdict values; changes to round budgets or lane rules; re-running historic reviews.

## Acceptance
- An aspect whose required material is missing never yields pass, proven by one test per aspect
- Every new aspect verdict record carries observed and missing material
- AspectStatus keeps exactly pass, concerns and block, and lane decisions for complete material are unchanged in existing tests
- The review view shows the coverage line in light and dark captures

implementationTasks.promptMarkdown:
# Sampled re-review of accepted cards

Source: docs/luhmann-systems-theory/index.html (AGT-3606), decision LT-D3, principle P7. Read that Dossier's sections Organisation (uncertainty absorption), Alternatives LT-D3, then AGENTS.md, docs/start/contribution-and-style-guide.html and docs/system/domains/review.md and docs/orchestrator-improvement-scout/index.html. Use the Dossier's recommended option unless a recorded owner decision selects another, and record in results/status.md which option you implemented. Persona slice keys (PT-n) map to AGT-3594 to AGT-3605 by assumption; confirm against card titles before depending on them.

Dependencies: scout slice IS-S3 (proposal lifecycle).

Entry points: The Watcher sweep (backend/Features/Watcher/WatcherHostedService.cs), central model selection, the requirement-fit / concept-fit aspect runner, the scout proposal path.

## Deliver
1. Each week select, with a recorded seed, up to two cards per project and at most six per workspace that were accepted 14 days earlier.
2. Run a fresh requirement-fit (or concept-fit) review through central model selection on the accepted tree, capped at 60,000 tokens per workspace-week, counted inside the persona pool when it exists and otherwise inside the Watcher contingent.
3. A disagreement with the original verdict becomes a finding with both verdicts linked; agreement is recorded. Publish the weekly agreement rate with its denominator.

## Out of scope
Moving, reopening or reverting any card; re-reviewing every card.

## Acceptance
- The sample respects both caps and is reproducible from its seed
- A disagreement produces exactly one finding linking both verdicts and the accepted tree
- No lane changes because of the sample, proven by a test
- Exhausting the token cap writes a no-call receipt instead of a review
